SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_CNT, DS_SEQ FROM IF_UCUBE_DS_SEND WHERE BUYER = 'KRSTX-0001' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' AND ROWNUM <= 100
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.LEGACY_PO_NO AS PO_NO, A.KEY_01 AS PO_HEADER_ID, A.KEY_02 AS PO_LINE_ID, A.KEY_03 AS PO_LINE_LOCATION_ID, A.KEY_04 AS PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID, A.KEY_05 AS PART_CD, A.DS_QTY AS SHIPMENT_QTY, A.DS_DATE AS SHIPMENT_DATE FROM IF_UCUBE_DS_SEND A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND A.LEGACY_PO_CNT = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_CNT$' AND A.DS_SEQ = '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$'
UPDATE IF_UCUBE_DS_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND LEGACY_PO_CNT = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_CNT$' AND DS_SEQ = '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$'
UPDATE IF_UCUBE_DS_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND LEGACY_PO_CNT = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_CNT$' AND DS_SEQ = '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$'
